name: Create Your Own ChatGPT System 🎁
description_md:
# What You Get
The Complete Setup Guide (PDF): A 9-page walkthrough covering everything from CLAUDE.md templates to MCP setup commands. Copy-paste ready prompts and beginner-friendly warnings included.
Gemini API Documentation: The exact reference file I use to give Claude Code knowledge of video understanding, image generation, and real-time voice. Updated December 2025 with Gemini 3 Pro and Nano Banana.
6 MCP Setup Commands: One-line copy-paste commands for Zapier (1000+ integrations), Firecrawl (web scraping), Supabase (database), n8n (automation), Playwright (browser), and 21st.dev Magic (UI components).
CLAUDE.md Template: The memory system that makes Claude Code remember your preferences across every session. No more repeating yourself.
Key Prompts Collection: The exact prompts I use for API documentation research, image generation, and hashtag memory setup.
Ecosystem Architecture: Visual overview of how Claude Code connects to Gemini, Zapier, Firecrawl, and Supabase to create a system that rivals ChatGPT Pro.
Stop paying $20/month for features you can build yourself.
This kit gives you everything you need to create your own AI ecosystem - voice, images, video understanding, 1000+ app integrations, and custom memory.
Works for non-technical users. After a week of setup, you will never look back.
Join the Early AI-dopters community for video walkthroughs and deeper dives: https://www.skool.com/earlyaidopters/about
